consultation.field.requirementsPlacehold: What are you evaluating? Tolerances, certifications, environment, failure modes — anything that helps us understand the engineering question.

consultation.scope.title: What this consultation is (and isn't)
consultation.scope.lead: We are an independent engineering knowledge hub, not a manufacturer, distributor, or broker. This form is a technical inbox — your message goes to our editorial team, not a sales queue.
consultation.scope.can1: Material selection between titanium grades (e.g. CP vs. Ti-6Al-4V vs. beta alloys) for a given duty cycle.
consultation.scope.can2: Process feasibility: which manufacturing route fits your geometry, tolerance, and batch size.
consultation.scope.can3: Surface treatment & finish trade-offs (anodizing vs. passivation vs. PVD, Ra targets, biocompatibility).
consultation.scope.can4: Qualification paths: which standards (ASTM, ASME, ISO 13485, AS9100D, NADCAP) apply to your use case.
consultation.scope.cant1: Quote prices, lead times, or accept purchase orders.
consultation.scope.cant2: Source suppliers, broker transactions, or introduce you to specific vendors.
consultation.scope.cant3: Accept confidential CAD drawings or proprietary part numbers via this form.
consultation.scope.cant4: Provide regulatory, legal, or investment advice.
consultation.consent: I understand this is an independent technical consultation, not a commercial offer, and consent to being contacted by email regarding my inquiry.
consultation.disclaimer: By submitting this form you agree to be contacted by email regarding your inquiry. We do not add you to any newsletter, share your details with third parties, or use this form to solicit business.
